design.identity: Massive four-legged charcoal stag-lion beast, long ivory false-crown antlers, carved bone face mask, moss-green ceremonial mane, hanging burgundy torn pennants, split dark hooves. Exactly four legs, one head, two antlers.
design.idle: Braced hooves, visibly breathing rib cage, head lowers and rises, antlers tilt through neck joint, mane and pennants sway; complete seamless cycle with distinct intermediate poses.
design.attack: Rear onto hind legs, fold front hooves, drive both front legs down in a huge stomp then thrust masked head LEFT; recover four-hoof stance.
design.cast: Crouch deeply, arch neck back and spread antlers in a large roaring pose, mane expands, ritual glow under mask; lower neck and settle.
design.death: Antlers tilt as forelegs buckle; massive body rolls onto side, mask stays attached, mane and pennants settle into a coherent fallen beast.

design.identity: Thin masked woodland ritual follower, ivory crescent bone mask, charcoal face void, short moss-green feather mantle, burgundy waist wraps, two bare clawed feet, one curved ivory bone blade held in right hand, left hand empty.
design.idle: Feet brace, bent knees pulse, masked head scans, forearms flex and bone blade tilts visibly, mantle sways in a seamless cycle.
design.attack: 单次连贯的弧形斩击。右手连续举刃、转肩向左下挥，顺势压低重心，刀尖沿原弧收回。
design.cast: Squat and fold elbows, rise high on bent legs, both arms sweep into a wide ritual dance, mask bows and mantle flares; settle.
design.death: Blade slips to ground, knees fold, masked body falls sideways and mantle settles; no disappearance.

design.identity: Tall woodland priest with a long ivory owl-bone mask, branching antler headdress, deep moss-green layered ritual robe, burgundy hanging cords, two clawed hands, right hand holds a gnarled staff with a hollow bone ring, exactly two feet beneath robe.
design.idle: Substantial shoulder breathing, head bows at neck, wrists rotate and staff leans around planted tip, robe cords sway without feet skating.
design.attack: Draw left palm to chest, coil entire upper body and thrust left arm LEFT, release a small attached jade orb while staff braces, recoil.
design.cast: Kneel low, staff and empty left hand sweep high overhead, back arches and sleeves open wide, ring glows; recover a neutral standing silhouette.
design.death: Antler crown drops forward, staff tilts and falls, knees fold under robe, priest slumps to side as jade glow fades.

design.identity: Floating dark violet-black shadow creature beneath one large cracked ivory theater face mask, three smaller blank masks hanging on thin black tendrils, two long ribbon-like claw arms, lower body tapers into three curling ink tails; no legs.
design.idle: Main mask nods clearly, claw elbows unfold and curl, three tails counterwave and hanging masks swing; central mask remains near fixed hover height.
design.attack: Main mask coils back, two long arms gather, one claw drives a pronounced LEFT spear thrust with body twist then retracts.
design.cast: Main mask tilts aside to reveal a dark face void, three masks orbit through distinct positions while arms open extremely wide; re-mask and reset.
design.death: Mask cracks into a few large coherent pieces, tendrils lose tension, shadow unravels downward into curled ribbons and settled mask shards.

design.identity: Preserve reference exactly: massive coiled slate-blue ridged reef shell with pale barnacle holes, long ivory bony neck and hooked face, single cyan eye, hanging green algae, two long ivory scythe foreclaws and short supporting shell legs.
design.idle: Shell remains planted while long neck lifts and curls, foreclaw joints open and fold, algae swings with breathing in a clear seamless cycle.
design.attack: Retract head, raise both scythe foreclaws high, slash them LEFT in alternating heavy arcs, neck follows then recoil.
design.cast: Neck extends very high, shell mantle hinges open slightly, claws spread wide and cyan soul siphon gathers at mouth; close and lower.
design.death: Cyan eye extinguishes, scythe limbs fold inward, long neck slumps over grounded shell, algae and foreclaws settle coherently.

design.identity: Preserve reference identity, silhouette, fin count, facial features and colors exactly; enormous spectral abyssal fish with cyan soul glow. No newly invented limbs or props.
design.idle: Fixed hover core, gills and jaws visibly breathe, spine bends side to side and fins spread and fold through a full seamless swimming cycle.
design.attack: Curl spine into tight C, open jaws and lunge head LEFT with spinal wave, fins brake and recover.
design.cast: Head tilts sharply upward, mouth and gill covers open wide, fins spread and a cyan lure gathers at mouth; body rolls subtly then returns.
design.death: Fins lose tension, jaw slackens, soul glow drains, fish tilts onto side and slowly descends to a coherent fallen form.

design.identity: Huge squat ancient grey-stone and oxidized brass hydraulic golem, two thick articulated stone legs, two huge segmented arms, asymmetric shoulder aqueduct, massive circular waterwheel behind upper torso, ribbed bronze chest pressure tank filled with pale cyan water, narrow cyan face slit, moss and mineral crust.
design.idle: Feet firmly planted, chest tank visibly pumps, shoulders and elbows rise and lower, head slit tips, waterwheel rotates incrementally and water swells, seamless cycle.
design.attack: Compress knees and chamber, raise huge right stone fist then drive a broad LEFT punch while left arm braces, hips rotate and recover.
design.cast: Squat under pressure, arch waterwheel and spread elbows, lean chest strongly LEFT and open tank vent for water-pressure cannon; valve closes and settle.
design.death: Water pressure fails, wheel stalls, knees shear, stone torso sinks and breaks into several heavy plates with wheel resting beside rubble; no vanishing.

design.identity: Colossal burgundy crab-pincer construct, curved segmented smoke-violet stalk on three small chitin anchor legs, one gigantic ivory-edged crushing pincer on top, amber inner eye, not a humanoid. Same shell material and scale family as reference spray pincer.
design.idle: Base stays anchored, stalk flexes at hinges, huge pincer visibly opens and closes, amber core pulses in a full breathing cycle.
design.attack: Stalk curls far back, pincer opens very wide then drives LEFT and snaps shut, hinge plates follow and recoil.
design.cast: Stalk compresses low then rises almost vertical, pincer presents broad shell as shield, shell plates expand and lock before returning.
design.death: Inner eye darkens, stalk hinges buckle sequentially, huge pincer lands on side and settles beside folded anchor legs.

design.identity: Preserve reference exactly: tall curved burgundy chitin stalk with dark violet ribbed inner joints, giant open ivory-edged pincer jaws, orange circular furnace eye between upper jaws, sharp asymmetric ivory shell plates and grounded hooked lower base. No extra legs or arms.
design.idle: Lower hooked base holds, stalk hinges flex with pressure breathing, upper jaws open and close, furnace eye brightens and dims; seamless cycle.
design.attack: Compress stalk, recoil upper jaws then thrust them LEFT, furnace eye vents a small attached flame, jaws remain coherent; recoil.
design.cast: Bend stalk far backward to pressurize, spread jaws extremely wide, lean strongly LEFT and expose furnace nozzle; vent and recover.
design.death: Orange eye flickers out, jaws sag, stalk folds joint by joint into a coherent grounded segmented heap.

design.identity: Tall hunched violet demon scholar with ivory horned skull face, one glowing amber forehead eye, burgundy layered mantle, two long claw arms cradling one giant chained ivory-page book, two bent digitigrade legs, small folded black wing membranes. One book only.
design.idle: Bent legs brace, neck and shoulders breathe, fingers turn one book page, head tracks across page, chains sway; seamless cycle.
design.attack: Book held in left claw, right claw pulls back high then performs a heavy LEFT palm strike, torso twists and resets.
design.cast: Hunch over closed book then open it very wide above chest, head arches, wing membranes spread and fingers splay in a huge revelation gesture; close to neutral.
design.death: Book falls open, wing membranes fold, legs buckle and scholar collapses around book, chains settle while amber eye extinguishes.

design.identity: Enormous low burgundy-violet fleshy maw beast, one huge vertical ivory-toothed mouth occupying front torso, eyeless upper dome, four short hooked supporting limbs, overlapping chitin back ridges, long drooling tongue, no separate humanoid head.
design.idle: Four feet hold, belly heaves visibly, tooth arches open and close slightly, tongue curls and back plates breathe; seamless cycle.
design.attack: Rear torso contracts, mouth opens huge, full body drives LEFT in a great bite, jaw arches clamp and tongue recoils; return.
design.cast: Lower belly presses to ground then upper dome rears, mouth opens almost circular and tongue sweeps a wide spiral, abdomen expands; exhale and reset.
design.death: Mouth tension fails, tooth arches fold inward, body rolls onto side, tongue and back plates settle, no gore.

design.identity: Floating giant ancient hourglass, two cold-silver ornate end caps and three curved obsidian support struts, intact elongated pale violet glass bulbs, bright golden-ivory sand stream, small silver clockwork halo, no humanoid face or limbs.
design.idle: Hover center holds, hourglass tilts through a clear slow cycle, sand swirls visibly, support struts flex subtly and halo turns; seamless.
design.attack: Glass assembly leans back then pivots sharply LEFT, bottom cap aims and releases a narrow attached sand-light needle, returns upright.
design.cast: Hourglass rotates a full half turn through intermediate poses, sand coils upward against gravity, struts spread slightly and halo opens; return original orientation.
design.death: Sand stream stops, bulbs crack into several large pieces, end caps fall and tilt, sand pours into a final settled mound among silver struts.

design.identity: Preserve reference exactly: torch-headed amalgam, established body shape, joints, appendage count, armor and flame placement, no additional heads or weapons.
design.idle: Feet or visible base hold, torso and head articulate visibly, attached torch flame bends and breathes, arms flex with the reference anatomy in seamless cycle.
design.attack: Lower head and compress supporting limbs, then drive whole torso LEFT into a heavy torch-head ram, attached flame trails modestly, recover.
design.cast: Compress shoulders, lift torch head high, open limbs wide and arch torso as flame elongates vertically, then retract flame and settle.
design.death: Torch head extinguishes progressively, supports buckle and body collapses sideways, attached parts settle as a few embers die.

design.identity: Tall long-night puppet queen with pale ivory angular face, narrow crimson eyes, cold silver many-spiked crown, deep burgundy court gown over black armor, two long articulated arms, silver finger claws with fine puppet threads, two armored feet and split trailing skirt. No staff or sword.
design.idle: Feet hold, rib cage and shoulders breathe, crowned head turns slightly, finger joints independently curl and puppet threads sway; skirt follows a clear seamless cycle.
design.attack: Right elbow draws behind crown, torso twists and both claw hands snap LEFT in a decisive guillotine pull, threads follow then return.
design.cast: Bow deeply, raise both hands above crown, spread fingers and elbows extremely wide, puppet threads unfurl around torso, straighten and draw threads inward.
design.death: Threads snap sequentially, crown tips, queen drops to knees and falls sideways, gown settles around coherent fallen armor and dim crown.

design.identity: Massive experimental quadruped beast with pale ivory stitched skull mask, charcoal-violet sinewy torso, two enormous front claw arms and two smaller hind legs, cold silver restraints, burgundy back plates and one sealed orange furnace in chest. Exactly four limbs, one skull.
design.idle: Four limb contacts hold, huge chest visibly inflates, skull dips and neck stretches, front claws flex and restraints sway; seamless cycle.
design.attack: Lower hindquarters, draw one giant foreclaw high behind skull then perform two heavy LEFT claw rakes and jaw snap; recover.
design.cast: Rear strongly onto hind legs, spread huge front arms, skull arches back and chest furnace opens, whole back flexes in a powerful roar; return four limbs.
design.death: Furnace fades, restraints loosen, forelimbs collapse, heavy body rolls onto side and skull lowers to ground, coherent stable corpse without gore.
